newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: First Holdings to issue $300 mln notes.
newsitem.headline: First Holdings to issue $300 mln notes.

text.p: First Philippine Holdings Corp said on Friday its board had approved the issuance of $300 million worth of Euroconvertible notes.
In a statement to the Philippine Stock Exchange, the firm also said its board had approved the appointment of Deutsche Morgan Grenfell as the global coordinator and lead manager.
First Holdings said it will create a special purpose vehicle registered in the Cayman Islands that will issue the notes.
The firm did not disclose the terms of the proposed debt issue.
First Holdings has interests in oil exploration, power generation, real estate and infrastructure.
